# UGC3580 Table 6 geometry transcription v01

This CSV is a manual transcription of the UGC 3580 rows in Table 6 of
Jozsa (2007), *Kinematic modelling of disk galaxies. II. A case-study of
symmetrically warped galaxy disks*, A&A 468, 903-917.

Included source fields are radius, H I surface density, inclination, position
angle, the three published spin-normal components, tip angle and line of nodes,
with their quoted errors. The published rotation-velocity columns are
deliberately omitted. The `420 arcsec` row is retained as a source record but
lies beyond the source terminal radius `375 +/- 30 arcsec`; downstream primary
geometry summaries must exclude it and may use it only as a declared support
sensitivity.

Source PDF SHA-256:
`15b4ae9e2bb3268509e75b40e62def8cc4664a117fdcccafae8afb7f170ec8ba`.

Epistemic status: source transcription, not a fitted model and not a rotation
endpoint.
